notes: Run with a throwaway workspace root that has the real ~/workspace/CLAUDE.md copied in; tell the agent that root stands for ~/workspace. Script checks are marked script.

evals.prompt: create new project in ~/workspace for a small python cli that tracks rising chinese github repos daily. init okf and agent md and claude md for it, mise too
evals.expected_output: Creates tools/<kebab-name>/ (a CLI is a tool), git init, a stack .gitignore, mise.toml pinning python with real tasks, AGENTS.md describing the project and the OKF update rule, CLAUDE.md that is only @AGENTS.md, a valid .okf bundle with real concepts, asks before codegraph init, does not commit, gives the full path.

assertions.text: project is under tools/ in kebab-case
AGENTS.md says to update .okf in the same change

evals.prompt: move this code into a new project under workspace and setup okf for this project based on exits docs
evals.expected_output: Moves the scratch folder (with its README and docs/) into the right category, keeps its git history, builds the OKF concepts from the existing docs instead of copying them wholesale, and writes AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.

assertions.text: original git history is preserved (same root commit)
concepts reflect the existing docs' content
